# openstatus_private_location (Data Source)

Fetches a single private location by ID, including its agent token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openstatus_private_location" "eu_dc" {
  id = "pl_123"
}

output "private_location_status" {
  value = data.openstatus_private_location.eu_dc.status
}

output "private_location_last_seen_at" {
  value = data.openstatus_private_location.eu_dc.last_seen_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the private location.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `last_seen_at` (String) When the agent last reported a result (RFC 3339). Null if it never has.
- `metadata` (Map of String)
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String)
- `name` (String)
- `status` (String) Computed health of the agent: `active`, `error`, or `unknown`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Agent credential. Treat it as a secret.
- `updated_at` (String)
